findings.statement: EU retention for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026 is 18 months, effective 1 March 2026.
findings.qualifier: Applies only to EU accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026.

findings.statement: EU retention for accounts opened before 1 January 2026 remains 12 months.
findings.qualifier: Applies to EU accounts opened before 1 January 2026.

findings.statement: Standard non-EU retention is 24 months after contract termination.
Draft Amendment B proposes a 24-month EU period but is unsigned and not in effect.
findings.qualifier: Not approved; the 1 September 2026 effective date is proposed, not operative.

findings.statement: The public trust page shows 12 months for EU accounts and is not current.
findings.qualifier: Snapshot dated 18 April 2026; not updated after Amendment A.

findings.statement: The system-of-record export shows 12 months for EU accounts and is stale, not controlling.
findings.qualifier: Export dated 15 April 2026; stale for accounts opened on or after 1 January 2026.

findings.statement: Backups are retained for 35 days under a separate schedule and are out of scope of the retention policy.
findings.qualifier: Separate Backup Retention Schedule; not covered by the Enterprise Data Retention Policy.

findings.statement: Amendment A took effect on 1 March 2026, before it was signed on 5 May 2026.
findings.qualifier: Effective 1 March 2026, before the 5 May 2026 signature.

findings.statement: Two distinct outages occurred in March 2026.
findings.qualifier: INC-031 on 2 March and INC-032 on 4 March.

findings.statement: INC-031 on 2 March lasted 75 minutes, was caused by an expired TLS certificate, and caused 12,400 failed transactions.
INC-032 on 4 March lasted 45 minutes, was caused by a failed rollback, and caused 3,100 failed transactions.
The total impact was 15,500 failed transactions, and the two incidents had different causes.
The draft remediation plan is not approved; the root-cause note recommends rotating certificates, re-enabling expiry alerts, and adding a weekly inventory check.
